chapters.title: My First 100 Words
chapters.description: Delightful early reading and discovery in Vocabulary

pages.title: My Loving Family & People
bulletPoints: Mama (Mother): Warm hugs, gentle smiles, and sweet bedtime songs.
Papa (Father): Strong hands, playful piggyback rides, and bedtime stories.
Baby: Tiny toes, soft giggles, and cozy woolen blankets.
Brother & Sister: Sharing colorful toys, racing in the yard, and holding hands.
Grandma & Grandpa: Loving rocking chairs, warm milk, and timeless grandfather tales.

pages.title: Parts of My Amazing Body
bulletPoints: Eyes: Two bright eyes to see colorful flowers, books, and smiling friends.
Ears: Two listening ears to hear birds chirping and musical songs.
Nose: One little nose to smell cinnamon cookies and garden roses.
Mouth: Smiling lips, gentle teeth, and a tasting tongue for sweet apples.
Hands & Feet: Clapping hands with ten fingers and hopping feet with ten toes!

pages.title: Getting Dressed: My Clothes
bulletPoints: Shirt: Soft cotton t-shirt with bright buttons and colorful stripes.
Pants & Shorts: Sturdy denim trousers with pockets for shiny pebbles.
Shoes & Socks: Warm woolen socks and snug sneakers with Velcro straps.
Warm Jacket: Puffy winter coat with a zipper and fluffy hood.
Sun Hat: Wide-brimmed straw hat keeping sunbeams off our faces.

pages.title: In the Kitchen: Breakfast Time
bulletPoints: Plate & Bowl: Ceramic dishes holding warm golden oatmeal and fruits.
Spoon & Fork: Shiny utensils for scooping yogurt and picking berries.
Cup & Mug: Drinking clear water and steaming chamomile tea.
Napkin: Soft cloth for wiping sticky jam off rosy cheeks.
Teapot: Whistling gently on the stove when water is boiling hot.

pages.title: Sweet and Juicy Fruits
bulletPoints: Apple: Crisp red or green fruit that goes "crunch" when you bite!
Banana: Peel the yellow jacket to reveal the sweet, creamy fruit.
Orange: Plump citrus spheres packed with vitamin C and sunshine drops.
Mango: Golden tropical treasure with honey-sweet fragrant slices.
Berries: Tiny blue and red gems bursting with sweet juice in your mouth.

pages.title: Crunchy Garden Vegetables
bulletPoints: Carrot: Bright orange crunchy taproots that bunnies love to nibble.
Green Peas: Sweet little green marbles hiding in a velvet pod.
Potato: Earthy brown tubers that mash into fluffy buttery clouds.
Tomato: Plump ruby red garden fruits that make delicious pizza sauce.
Corn: Golden rows of sweet kernels wrapped in leafy green husks.

pages.title: The Cozy Living Room
bulletPoints: Sofa: Long, comfortable couch with squishy cushions for storytime.
Table: Sturdy wooden surface where we draw with crayons and play puzzles.
Lamp: Warm golden light casting cozy shadows on the wall.
Rug: Soft woven carpet where we sit cross-legged and stack blocks.
Clock: Friendly tick-tock pendulum counting minutes until playtime.

pages.title: The Peaceful Bedroom
bulletPoints: Bed: Soft mattress and warm quilt welcoming sweet evening dreams.
Pillow: Fluffy cloud where we rest our sleepy heads.
Teddy Bear: Furry plush friend with button eyes who shares every secret.
Nightlight: Gentle glowing star chasing away the dark corners.
Window: Looking out at the twinkling moon and whisper of the night breeze.

pages.title: Bath Time Splashing
bulletPoints: Bathtub: Warm water filled with bubbly mountains of suds.
Soap: Smelling like lavender and making slippery white bubbles.
Towel: Big, fluffy cotton towel wrapping us warm like a cozy burrito.
Rubber Duck: Floating yellow toy that squeaks when squeezed.
Toothbrush: Scrubbing teeth in circles before bed to keep them pearly white!

pages.title: My Favorite Toys
bulletPoints: Ball: Bouncy rubber sphere that rolls across the floor and catches in hands.
Building Blocks: Wooden cubes, cylinders, and arches creating tall towers.
Toy Train: Chugga-chugga engine pulling colorful freight cars on tracks.
Puzzle: Fitting wooden animal pieces together with satisfying clicks.
Crayons: A box of 24 rainbow sticks ready to color blank paper.

pages.title: Friendly Household Pets
bulletPoints: Puppy: Wagging tail, wet nose, and playful "Woof!" chasing tennis balls.
Kitten: Soft purrs, sandpaper tongue, and gentle paws batting yarn.
Goldfish: Glittering orange fins gliding silently through clean water.
Parakeet: Green and yellow feathered friend chirping merry whistles.
Bunny: Long twitching ears and a soft cotton-tail hopping in clover.

pages.title: Wild Safari Animals
bulletPoints: Lion: Golden mane and mighty roar, King of the African savanna.
Elephant: Gentle giant with a long curling trunk and broad flapping ears.
Giraffe: Tallest animal on Earth, nibbling sweet acacia leaves high above.
Zebra: Crisp black and white stripes galloping across open grasslands.
Monkey: Long curly tail swinging playfully through jungle canopy vines.

pages.title: Things on Wheels: Vehicles
bulletPoints: Bicycle: Two wheels, two pedals, and a ringing bell on the handlebar.
Car: Four wheels carrying families safely on roads and highways.
School Bus: Big bright yellow bus picking up neighborhood students.
Firetruck: Loud siren, flashing red lights, and a long extending ladder.
Train: Long line of passenger cars gliding swiftly along steel tracks.

pages.title: Up in the Sky
bulletPoints: Sun: Giant glowing ball of warm light bringing daytime and warmth.
Moon: Silver crescent smiling gently down across the sleeping world.
Stars: Countless twinkling diamonds scattered across velvet night.
Clouds: Fluffy white cotton balls drifting across the bright blue sky.
Airplane: Silver bird with wings flying high above the cloud tops.

pages.title: The Great Outdoors: Nature
bulletPoints: Tree: Tall oak and pine with leafy branches sheltering songbirds.
Flower: Colorful fragrant petals opening to greet morning sunshine.
Grass: Soft green carpet beneath bare feet on a warm afternoon.
River: Cool, sparkling fresh water rushing over smooth river rocks.
Mountain: Majestic stone peak touching the sky with a snowy cap.

pages.title: Action Words: Things We Do
bulletPoints: Jump: Leaping high off the ground with both feet!
Run: Moving legs swiftly across the green grass.
Clap: Bringing two happy hands together to make a rhythmic sound.
Sing: Using our voice to make melodious, cheerful tunes.
Sleep: Closing tired eyes and drifting peacefully into dreamland.

pages.title: Opposites: Exploring Contrasts
bulletPoints: Big and Small: An enormous elephant beside a tiny field mouse.
Hot and Cold: Steaming vegetable soup vs a chilly fruit popsicle.
Fast and Slow: A sprinting cheetah vs a slow-plodding garden snail.
Up and Down: Climbing high up a ladder vs sliding down the slide.
Happy and Sad: A beaming warm smile vs a comforting supportive hug.

pages.title: Polite Words: The Magic Keys
bulletPoints: Please: The magic word that opens doors when asking for help.
Thank You: Grateful words that make hearts warm when receiving kindness.
You're Welcome: A friendly reply when someone thanks you warmly.
Excuse Me: Polite words when passing by or needing someone's attention.
I'm Sorry: Courageous words to heal feelings when an accident happens.

pages.title: Our Feelings & Emotions
bulletPoints: Happy: Smiling from ear to ear, dancing, and laughing out loud.
Curious: Wondering how butterflies fly and asking "why?" with bright eyes.
Calm: Breathing deep and slow like gentle ripples on a quiet pond.
Brave: Taking a deep breath and trying something new even when nervous.
Loving: Wrapping friends and family in warm, caring embraces.

pages.title: My 100 Words Celebration
bulletPoints: You now know 100 first words: People, animals, foods, actions, and wonders!
Every word you learn is a building block to express your ideas and dreams.
Read words on cereal boxes, street signs, and favorite bedtime books.
Congratulations: You are a confident young reader with a rich vocabulary!
